title: tyrus-fmt Configuration
description: Configuration schema for the tyrus formatter.

array_expand.description: When to expand array literals to multi-line, or off to keep them inline even past line_width.

blank_lines.description: Blank lines between imports/items sections and around control flow blocks.

blank_lines_around_blocks.description: Whether to add a blank line before and after block statements (if, for, while, do...while, match, switch) and function declarations.

blank_lines_around_decorations.description: Whether to add a blank line around interface/type fields that carry validator decorations.

brace_spacing.description: Space between curly braces and their content.

brace_style.description: Placement of opening braces, or off to preserve each source layout.

final_newline.description: Whether to end the file with a newline.

indent_width.description: Number of spaces per indentation level.

imports_sort.description: Sort imports alphabetically; true enables sorting with language imports (tyrus:…) grouped at top.

object_expand.description: When to expand object literals to multi-line, or off to keep them inline even past line_width.

pipeline_chain_layout.description: How to print pipeline chains with more than one |>, or off to preserve each chain's original layout.

prefer_arrow_function.description: Force a top-level function declaration to a const bound to an arrow function (true), or leave each declaration in whichever form it was written, mixing function and arrow freely (false).

quote_style.description: Preferred quotation mark for string literals, or off to preserve the delimiter and escapes written in the source.

remove_unused_imports.description: Remove unused import specifiers and delete import declarations that become empty.

trailing_comma.description: Whether to add trailing commas to multi-line literals.
